stories.title: 79th Independence Day (15 August)
stories.body: themes 'Naya Bharat', '150 Years of Vande Mataram' and 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'; PM Modi's record 103-minute, 13th consecutive Red Fort address covering the Emergency, Operation Sindoor, 'Made in India' defence, semiconductors, critical minerals, women empowerment and RSS's centenary year; Flying Officer Rashika Sharma assists the flag-hoisting; two Mi-17 helicopters shower petals — one carrying the national flag, the other an Operation Sindoor flag; 2,500 NCC cadets and My Bharat volunteers form the 'Naya Bharat' logo.
